## Findings

- **BERT-base — combined vs separate:** separate champions imply an expected combined-val accuracy of 52.9%; the combined-trained champion reaches 50.4% (-2.5 pts → combined training does not help). Note: the exact per-subset split of the combined champion still needs the two decomposition evals (commands below).
- **DeBERTa-v3-base — combined vs separate:** separate champions imply an expected combined-val accuracy of 67.9%; the combined-trained champion reaches 70.0% (+2.1 pts → combined training helps). Note: the exact per-subset split of the combined champion still needs the two decomposition evals (commands below).
- **DeBERTa-v3-base vs BERT-base on easy:** +17.9 pts, two-proportion p = 0.0000 (significant at 0.05).
- **DeBERTa-v3-base vs BERT-base on challenge:** +9.4 pts, two-proportion p = 0.0219 (significant at 0.05).
- **DeBERTa-v3-base vs BERT-base on combined:** +19.6 pts, two-proportion p = 0.0000 (significant at 0.05).
